title: fix: show positive pollen gap for tied standings
author: CloudCompile

gist.summary: Tied Quest leaderboard rows now show the minimum positive gap of 0.25 Pollen needed to overtake the user above, rather than showing zero. Added a focused rendering regression test.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel garden, Polli wears a tiny scorekeeper visor and points to two tied leaderboard rows beside a lime green (#ecf874) flower pot; a small pixel sign reads '0.25 Pollen'. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She is small-to-medium sized within the scene, never oversized or dominating the image, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with warm cream and lavender behind chunky sprites and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
